name: rithanya-hospital-platform
description: Rithanya Hospital & Daycare Transfusion Centre - Enterprise Full Stack Healthcare Platform

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install && cd ..
scripts.postinstall: cd server && npm install && npx prisma generate && cd ../client && npm install && cd ..
scripts.build: cd client && npm run build && cd ../server && npx prisma generate
scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev:server'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev:client'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true });"
scripts.db:push: cd server && npx prisma db push --accept-data-loss
scripts.db:reset: npm run db:push && npm run db:seed

author: Rithanya Hospital
